description: Provision a Google Cloud Tags TagsLocationTagBinding via Config Connector. Fields mirror the tags.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1 TagsLocationTagBinding spec.

location.description: The location for the resource being tagged.

parentRef.description: ParentRef is a reference to a parent resource. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: Allowed value: string of the format `//cloudresourcemanager.googleapis.com/projects/{{value}}`, where {{value}} is the `number` field of a `Project` resource.

kind.description: Kind to which we are binding the tag.  Defaults to Project if not specified.

name.description: Name of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#names

namespace.description: Namespace of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/namespaces/

projectId.description: GCP project ID for this resource. Rendered as the cnrm.cloud.google.com/project-id annotation. Leave empty to inherit the project from the namespace (Config Connector falls back to the namespace's project-id annotation, then to the namespace name). Leave empty when this resource's spec already carries a projectRef.
projectId.title: GCP project ID

resourceID.description: The service-generated name of the resource. Used for acquisition only. Leave unset to create a new resource.

tagValueRef.description: TagsTagValueRef is a reference to a TagsTagValue resource. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: A reference to an externally managed TagsTagValue resource. Should be in the format "tagValues/{{tagValueID}}".

name.description: The name of a TagsTagValue resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of a TagsTagValue resource.
